description:
You are a hospital Quality Improvement Coordinator. A serious medication safety event occurred (10x Heparin Overdose), and you must complete the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) visual diagram for the safety committee.

Files provided:
1. '~/Diagrams/medication_rca.drawio' - A skeleton Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram with the effect and main categories already drawn.
2. '~/Desktop/incident_investigation_report.txt' - The full investigation findings.

Your task:
1. Open the skeleton diagram in draw.io.
2. Read the investigation report to identify contributing factors.
3. Populate the fishbone diagram by adding SHAPES (rectangles or text) for every contributing factor mentioned in the report, connecting them to the appropriate category branches (People, Process, Equipment, Environment, Materials, Management).
4. Include second-level causes (sub-causes) where the report provides deeper analysis ('Why?').
5. Apply COLOR CODING: Use a distinct fill color for each of the 6 category branches/groups to make them visually distinct.
6. Add a TITLE at the top: 'RCA-2024-0847: Heparin Overdose Incident — Root Cause Analysis'.
7. Save the diagram.
8. Export the final diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/exports/medication_rca.pdf'.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- The diagram must contain at least 20 specific causes from the report.
- Each category must be color-coded differently.
- The text must be legible and properly connected.
